name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois brings a blend of Belgian culinary artistry and uncompromising efficiency to Porsche Penske Motorsport. Her journey began in her family's esteemed patisserie in Bruges, where she honed her skills in crafting delectable treats and managing a bustling kitchen. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Sophie saw an opportunity to combine her passions, recognizing that a well-fed team is a high-performing team. She joined the racing world initially as a volunteer, quickly proving her organizational prowess and culinary talent.

Sophie's approach to catering is rooted in the belief that meals are more than just sustenance; they are opportunities to build camaraderie and boost morale. Her menus are meticulously planned, taking into consideration dietary needs and preferences, ensuring that every team member feels valued and energized. What sets Sophie apart is her unwavering commitment to quality and her ability to create a welcoming and comforting atmosphere, even amidst the high-pressure environment of the racetrack. She is known to source local ingredients wherever possible to deliver the best experience for the team.

Her demanding nature stems from her high standards, ensuring that every meal is executed to perfection, and every team member is satisfied. She knows that the best way to the driver's best lap time, is through their stomach!

physical.description: Sophie is a woman of average height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using only Belgian chocolate in desserts, even if it means importing it.
Always has a stash of speculoos cookies in her catering van.
Refers to team members by endearingly stern nicknames, like 'my little racer' or 'my persistent engineer'.
